items.item: The drawings agree on site geometry, retained component locations, room layout, openings and public, item and cart routes.
Applicable drawings repeat the specifications' room facts, component IDs, material construction and levels without contradiction.
All eight views depict the source layout with consistent retained structure, rooflights, material divisions and new-room heights.
Visible furniture belongs to one unchanged inventory, including six teaching tables and four making benches.
The activity views show their prescribed populations and the other views show their assigned arrival, intake, teaching, making, lending and collection relationships.
The three details resolve the same construction assemblies and levels specified in the materials schedule and drawn in the sections.
Applicable details show 18 mm plywood, a 20 mm recessed brick junction, a 3100 mm room top and a concrete threshold meeting the yard at ±0.000.

requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Read the plan as a 30000 mm east–west by 24000 mm north–south site. The 24000 × 12000 mm hall starts at site coordinate (3000,9000), leaving 3000 mm west, east and north setbacks and a 9000 mm south yard. Show public arrival across the south yard to D-01 and item delivery to east-side D-02. Graphic orientation may vary if north and the relationships remain unambiguous; displaced boundaries, incorrect setbacks or swapped arrivals fail.

Compare existing and proposed geometry against the hall-local record, with origin at the southwest exterior corner. Exterior bounds are 24000 × 12000 mm and brick walls are 300 mm thick. C-01–C-05 lie at y=300 and C-06–C-10 at y=11700, using x=300, 6150, 12000, 17850 and 23700 in order; columns are 200 × 200 mm. T-01–T-05 connect corresponding south and north columns at these x coordinates. Retain W-01 south, W-02 east, W-03 north, W-04 west, S-01 slab and R-01 pitched roof. D-01 occupies south x=1500–4500; D-02 east y=1500–4500; D-03 north x=19500–20700. South windows O-01 and O-02 occupy x=7500–9900 and 14100–16500. North-pitch rooflights K-01–K-05 occupy y=7500–9500 and x=1200–4200, 5700–8700, 10200–13200, 14700–17700 and 19200–22200 respectively. Existing P-01 is centred at x=18000 over y=300–11700, 100 mm thick, and must disappear from the proposed built layout. Drawing conventions may vary; omission, relocation, resizing or invented retained openings fail.

Where visible, retain exposed brick, exposed steel columns and trusses, and a patched, sealed concrete floor. New enclosed rooms read as freestanding timber construction with birch plywood below clear upper glazing, leaving the existing roof structure exposed. Interior evidence should agree with plywood rising to 2100 mm, enclosed ceilings at 3000 mm and room tops at 3100 mm. Viewpoint and natural material variation are allowed; covering the retained structure or substituting a different construction system fails.

Both images place the exact project name and phrase at the south public entrance. Typography and sign arrangement may vary while remaining legible and attached to the correct entrance; missing wording, spelling changes or placement at a different frontage fail.

Use Course Day and Open Workshop as the respective view headings. Visibly account for 22 people in Course Day and 16 in Open Workshop, divided into the specified learner, maker and operator counts. Keep six teaching tables, twelve teaching chairs, four making benches and eight making stools in the same arrangement. Course Day has two learners at each table; Open Workshop has one; both have two makers at each bench and operators at Reception and Tool Store. Gestures and camera position may vary; uncountable or incorrect populations, changed inventory or switched headings fail.

Review the entire video for a ten-second spatial passage beginning at D-01, moving through Reception and reaching Teaching and Making. Compare the visible route, columns, openings, rooflights, material divisions, six teaching tables, four making benches and new-room heights with the drawings. Camera speed and framing may vary; a wrong route or duration, spatial discontinuity, or altered architecture or inventory fails.

requirementChecks.criteria: Judge each document for its assigned record. The room schedule contains A-01 Reception 18 m2, A-02 Teaching 54 m2, A-03 Making 60 m2, A-04 Tool Store 18 m2, A-05 Intake 12 m2, A-06 Collection 12 m2, A-07 Accessible Toilet 8 m2 and A-08 Staff Room 10 m2, all Ground Floor; A-04, A-07 and A-08 have 3000 mm clear height and the other rooms 4800 mm. Record Reception at D-01 beside Collection with a Tool Store counter sightline; Teaching beside Making and on the public route; Making connected to Intake and Collection; Intake beside D-02; Tool Store counter facing the public route; Accessible Toilet directly on that route; and Staff Room beside Tool Store. The materials schedule locates exposed repointed brick, cleaned and recoated steel, patched and sealed concrete, retained repaired corrugated roofing, and freestanding timber rooms with 18 mm birch plywood to 2100 mm, clear glazing above, ceiling underside 3000 mm, room top 3100 mm and a 20 mm recessed brick junction. The retention register records IDs, locations, conditions and treatments for C-01–C-10 and T-01–T-05 (oxidation; retain, clean and recoat), W-01–W-04 (mortar loss; retain and repoint), S-01 (chips; retain, patch and seal), R-01 (weathered coating; retain profile, repair and recoat), D-01–D-03 (weathered leaves; retain openings and refurbish), O-01–O-02 (weathered frames; retain and reglaze), K-01–K-05 (clouded glazing; retain apertures and reglaze), and P-01 (worn lining; remove). P-01 is 2400 mm high at x=18000, y=300–11700. Formatting and faithful paraphrase are allowed; missing records or changed commitments fail.

Use the room schedule as the source for all eight name–area labels on the proposed plan and for clear-height dimensions in the sections. Open zones show 4800 mm to truss underside; enclosed rooms show 3000 mm to ceiling underside. The transverse cut includes Teaching, a retained truss and a rooflight; the longitudinal cut includes the public route and new rooms. Annotation placement may vary; missing values or disagreement with the source or fixed programme fails.

The site and comparison sheets explicitly establish the specified site and hall dimensions, four 5850 mm bays, north, metric scale bars and ±0.000. Match retained component IDs to the source register in both plan states and wherever those components are represented in sections and elevations. P-01 is marked Removed and additions New. A component outside a cut or elevation need not be labelled there; missing relevant IDs, reassignment, absent plan annotations or ambiguous treatment fails.

All three plans agree on a dimensioned minimum 1500 mm unobstructed public route, D-01–Reception–Tool Store access and the D-02–Intake–Making–Collection sequence. Show borrowing and return between Reception, the tool counter and Teaching or Making. Locate six 1800 × 750 mm tables and twelve 450 × 450 mm chairs in Teaching; four 1800 × 900 mm benches and eight 400 × 400 mm stools in Making; a 2400 × 600 mm counter and three 1200 × 450 mm shelves in Tool Store; a 1600 × 700 mm reception desk; an 1800 × 750 mm intake table; and two 1200 × 450 mm collection shelves. Show two 900 × 600 mm carts, parked one in Intake and one in Collection, with passable routes to the counter and work areas. Preserve specified room adjacencies and the counter sightline from Reception. Graphic route coding may vary; missing inventory, contradictory paths or clearance obstructed by equipment fails.

Sections and elevations identify floor ±0.000, truss underside +4.800, eaves +5.400 and ridge +6.900. Preserve a centred pitched roof, 11400 mm transverse structural span and five truss centres at four 5850 mm spacings. Dimension south D-01 at x=1500–4500, threshold 0/head 3600; O-01 at x=7500–9900 and O-02 at x=14100–16500, sill 1800/head 3600. The east elevation contains only D-02 at y=1500–4500, threshold 0/head 3600; any depicted D-03 remains at north x=19500–20700, threshold 0/head 2400. Coordinate recorded north-pitch rooflights. Material labels and applicable details agree with the schedule: exposed brick and steel, timber studs, 18 mm birch plywood to 2100 mm, clear glazing above, 3000 mm ceiling underside, 3100 mm room top and a 20 mm recessed brick junction. The head detail leaves the truss exposed above the room; the threshold detail shows retained patched concrete and yard meeting at ±0.000. Detail scale and annotation style may vary; incompatible assemblies, levels, opening dimensions or an introduced step fail.

All eight eye-level views depict the documented hall, matching structure, openings, rooflights, material boundaries, freestanding-room heights and unchanged equipment layout. Confirm the requested subjects: south entrance; both occupied states; D-02 intake with cart and Making connection; Teaching looking toward Reception and the south entrance; Making looking east toward D-02; tool counter and shelving visibly related to Reception; and a repaired-item handover at Collection beside Reception. Camera positions and occlusion may vary if the requested spatial evidence remains readable. Missing subjects, invented openings, altered structure or contradictory furniture and room geometry fail.

Require at least twelve pages. Pages one, two and three cover the room, materials and retention specifications respectively; the first page may also serve as the cover, which prints COMMON REPAIR and Repair together. Repeat all eight room name–area pairs, 4800 mm open-zone and 3000 mm enclosed-room clear heights, Ground Floor/yard ±0.000 and component IDs consistent with the specifications. State complete building closure from 5 October through 13 December 2026 and reopening of the entire completed workshop on 14 December 2026. Equivalent unambiguous date formatting is allowed; displaced opening specification pages, missing repeated facts or a phased opening fails.

Every listed specification, drawing, detail and view is visibly reused in the presentation. Multiple sources may share a page, and scaling or legible excerpts are acceptable when source content remains identifiable. Title-only references, unreadably small reproductions, unrelated replacements or omitted sources fail.

The drawings agree on site geometry, retained component locations, room layout, openings and public, item and cart routes. Applicable drawings repeat the specifications' room facts, component IDs, material construction and levels without contradiction.

All eight views depict the source layout with consistent retained structure, rooflights, material divisions and new-room heights. Visible furniture belongs to one unchanged inventory, including six teaching tables and four making benches. The activity views show their prescribed populations and the other views show their assigned arrival, intake, teaching, making, lending and collection relationships.

The three details resolve the same construction assemblies and levels specified in the materials schedule and drawn in the sections. Applicable details show 18 mm plywood, a 20 mm recessed brick junction, a 3100 mm room top and a concrete threshold meeting the yard at ±0.000.
